summary: First test run for ROLLOW cafe management (Expo + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 22/23 pytest cases passed (95.6%). The one failure in TestPurchasing.test_pr_lifecycle is a parallel-test race (TestOpname concurrently adjusts Gula gudang stock by -5 in the same xdist run), NOT a backend bug — the API behavior itself is correct and verified by assertion of movement delta. All auth login flows for 6 roles, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/session invalid 401, RBAC 403s (crew->finance, marketing->POST sales, crew->users POST, crew->waste approve, crew->inventory move, finance->PR approve), POS integration chain (Es Teh Manis -> Gula bar -20 gram + sale hpp/profit + finance income + promo discount applied), POS summary & close (incl 400 on empty close), opname diff & stock adjust, waste approve deducts stock, PR create->approve->receive adds gudang stock + finance expense, inventory in/out/transfer, low-stock, attendance duplicate guard + lembur hours, payroll create (409 on duplicate) + pay creates Gaji expense, promo create + performance usage/revenue/discount, all 9 report types day/month, and role restrictions on reports (crew->sales 403, marketing->finance 403). Frontend: Indonesian UI loads, login screen with demo chips + Google button, dashboard renders per role (Owner cash flow + pending PR/waste, Finance quick menu Keuangan+Payroll+Laporan, Marketing shows Promo aktif + Marketing menu). Tab visibility verified: Finance and Marketing tabbars correctly show ONLY Beranda + Lainnya (Kasir and Stok hidden). Owner sees all 4 tabs. POS screen renders all 6 menus; tapping items works. Lainnya for Owner shows Absensi, Opname, Waste, Purchasing, Menu&Resep, Keuangan, Payroll, Marketing, Laporan, Karyawan + Keluar. No red-screen errors, no console errors blocking UI.

minor.issue: TestPurchasing.test_pr_lifecycle may fail intermittently when run with pytest-xdist in parallel with TestOpname (both mutate Gula gudang stock). Not a backend defect; recommend running with -p no:xdist or isolating Gula per test.

issues: Minor: tab-bar icons rendered as unicode glyphs (f382, f355) are vector-icon font PUA codepoints — expected for @expo/vector-icons web, not a bug.

action_items: (Optional) Make purchasing/opname tests use distinct ingredients or serialize to remove the xdist race in TestPurchasing.test_pr_lifecycle.
No functional fixes required — all critical flows (POS integration, RBAC, approvals, finance side-effects, reports) are green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 862-line file. Still readable and well-factored, but consider splitting into routers/ (auth, pos, inventory, purchasing, finance, payroll, attendance, marketing, reports) once feature-complete.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager when convenient.
google_session: httpx.AsyncClient should probably reuse a module-level client for perf, and the Emergent OAuth URL is hardcoded — consider env var.
list_finance uses raw db.finance.find without the find() helper (which strips _id and scopes outlet_id). It still scopes outlet_id and excludes _id so correct, but inconsistent with other listings.
No pagination on report rows or listings (hard 1000-2000 limits). Fine for MVP but will need pagination at scale.
update_user doesn't verify the uid exists before 200 (silently no-op on bad id). Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke-tested flows (login all roles, dashboard, POS render, tab RBAC, Lainnya modules, logout)

seed_data_creation: No manual seed — relied on backend startup seed (10 ingredients, 6 menus, Happy Hour 10% promo, 6 users). Test data prefixed TEST_ where applicable (TEST Promo, TEST customer, TEST reason).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) from /app/frontend/.env. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Run backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_rollow.py -v -p no:xdist to avoid the Gula-stock race between TestPurchasing and TestOpname. Google OAuth real flow cannot be automated; only /api/auth/session invalid 401 was asserted. Frontend testIDs confirmed: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, demo-chip-{role}. Tab bar uses text labels Beranda/Kasir/Stok/Lainnya (no stable testIDs on tab buttons observed — rely on get_by_text).
rca_of_issue: TestPurchasing failed assertion 95==100: TestOpname.test_opname_adjusts_stock sets Gula gudang physical = current-5, decrementing gudang by 5. When xdist schedules these two tests on different workers concurrently, both read Gula state, and the purchasing receive (+100) + opname delta (-5) net to +95 for the purchasing test's view. Mitigation: run with -p no:xdist or use distinct ingredients per test class.
